capabilities: Shows one day of Outlook calendar events in a sidebar panel
Drags events into notes as Markdown lines
Inserts the day's agenda with one command
Follows the date of the opened daily note
Highlights the current event and fades past ones
extras: Read-only: never creates, changes or answers anything in Outlook. No telemetry, ads or payments; event data enters the vault only when dragged or added. Last seven fetched days cached in local storage; sign-in token in Obsidian secret storage. Requires Obsidian 1.11.4+; its app registration can be shared with the Microsoft To Do Panel plugin.
problem: Obsidian has no view of your Outlook calendar, so checking today's meetings or adding them to notes means leaving the app.

relations.evidence: The plugin only reads your calendar. It never creates, changes or answers anything in Outlook.

requires.name: Microsoft account (work, school or personal) with an Outlook calendar
Microsoft Entra app registration (client ID, tenant, Calendars.Read permission)

summary: Sidebar panel showing one day of your Outlook calendar, with drag-and-drop event insertion into notes and daily-note following.
